events.description: A man in a gray suit (back to camera) is engaged in a physical confrontation with another man wearing glasses and a light shirt; the gray-suited man appears to be grabbing or shoving the other man, who reacts with visible distress and open mouth, while others intervene.

A physical altercation occurs in a locker room where multiple individuals, including shirtless players and suited staff, are engaged in mutual grappling and shoving; one man in a white shirt and tie is being held and pushed by several others.

A man in a white shirt and tie appears restrained and overwhelmed by multiple individuals, with hands on his shoulders and arms, suggesting he is a helpless victim of coordinated physical coercion during the altercation.
